context: Clarify benign fictional static depiction after rejected input; use only the precise canonical assembled reference, without unrelated neighbouring atlas parts.

arguments.prompt:
This is a static visual-depiction request for an existing fictional video-game trap as an unoccupied mechanical art prop. No event, victim, injury, operating instructions or construction instructions are requested. Depict the supplied inert assembly only.

Create ONE original DEADWALL source-art sprite proposal for the existing mechanism Câble anti-coureurs (runnerCable193), variant 0, mounted on its existing Hérisson support, completely at rest in the armed pose.

REFERENCE CONTRACT: Image 1 is the actual assembled sprite drawn by the UNCHANGED game renderer for this exact mechanism. It is the authority for silhouette, camera/projection, axes, every major part, every connection, relative size, overlap, and position. The aged original materials are already visible in image 1. Keep the assembled design of image 1. Refine materials, not geometry. This is one assembled object, never an exploded diagram or atlas.

CAMERA AND SCALE: Keep the same 2D sprite-plane projection and the same visible surfaces as image 1; do not rotate, mirror, tilt, reinterpret its elevation or rebuild it into a different perspective. Horizontal source X remains horizontal; source Y remains vertical downward. Preserve the full source silhouette and aspect ratio. The support has an authored 1 m by 1 m ground footprint; the native sprite owner is 32 by 32 units, with its drawing clipped to the existing 26 by 26 interior. These constrain its existing relative proportions; they are not permission to make all six silhouettes square. No mechanism height is specified. Do not add tall unseen faces, new supports or a new pedestal.

EXACT ASSEMBLY: Keep the low, broad horizontal two-rail timber-and-rusted-steel base. Keep its four end mounting bands. The mobile1 sliding/hooked crosspiece stands vertically just LEFT of centre, with the small hooked tip pointing LEFT in the lower half. The mobile2 toothed slider sits RIGHT of centre, horizontally, with its existing opposed teeth above and below. The distinctive Canvas193 hardware is TWO slender long vertical hook rails at the left and right positions shown: each has an inward slanted short return at its LOWER end, plus exactly ONE straight horizontal cable joining them above the middle. Preserve those two side uprights and both lower returns; do not shorten them to the wood base. Texture the pale olive-grey schematic hardware as simple dull worn metal/cable while retaining its complete silhouette and exact locations. Preserve the existing Hérisson underlay glimpses. No reel, extra coil, trigger pedal or new jaw.

STATE AND OWNERSHIP: The source contains the existing Hérisson support beneath one fixed mechanism base, TWO mobile parts frozen in their native armed pose, and its specialized hardware. Keep all visible pieces exactly where the reference places them. Full nominal charges (8) are a state value, not a quantity of loose physical supplies to draw. The assembly is unoccupied and still, with no effects and no UI marks. This is a static source illustration, not an animation replacement.

MATERIALS: Serious grounded repaired survival equipment. Match the original atlas's aged brown timber, dark oxidised steel, restrained iron-red rust, dull bolts and worn grey/olive hardware. Clearly readable existing edges and joins; no ornamental redesign, futuristic equipment, fantasy motifs or excessive new damage. Soft neutral illumination and crisp detailed silhouette. The original flat-colour specialized hardware should become believable material, not a painted annotation or diagram, but its count, topology and placement must remain unchanged.

OUTPUT: Exactly ONE complete isolated mounted mechanism, centred on TRUE transparent RGBA. Preserve every protruding existing part with at least 12 percent clear transparent margin on all four sides. No floor, terrain, base tile, ambient backdrop, coloured matte, cast shadow outside the object, labels, words, numerals, dimensions, watermark, logos, border, reference sheet or additional object. Keep the holes between parts transparent. Native PNG only.
